\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 206-209 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R214-first-pass-words-from-chapters-206-209}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for rare and frequent.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item breath, memory, wisdom, talent, a habit
  \item a generation, age, sunset; a setting, sunrise; a rising, first light
  \item finally, lastly, on the spot, formerly, long since
  \item a region, a province, from there; then, in the way, all the way
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Breath? (\textbf{anima, animae}.) Memory? (\textbf{memoria, memoriae}.) Wisdom? (\textbf{sapientia, sapientiae}.) Talent? (\textbf{ingenium, ingeniī}.) A habit? (\textbf{cōnsuētūdō, cōnsuētūdinis}.) A generation? (\textbf{saeculum, saeculī}.) Age? (\textbf{aetās, aetātis}.) Sunset; a setting? (\textbf{occāsus, occāsūs}.) Sunrise; a rising? (\textbf{ortus, ortūs}.) First light? (\textbf{dīlūculum, dīlūculī}.) Finally? (\textbf{dēnique}.) Lastly? (\textbf{postrēmō}.) On the spot? (\textbf{illicō}.) Formerly? (\textbf{quondam}.) Long since? (\textbf{iamdūdum}.) A region? (\textbf{regiō, regiōnis}.) A province? (\textbf{prōvincia, prōvinciae}.) From there; then? (\textbf{inde}.) In the way? (\textbf{obviam}.) All the way? (\textbf{usque}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 210-214 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R214-second-pass-words-from-chapters-210-214}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for moreover; however and indeed; but.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item moreover; however, indeed; but, surely, about, only; so much
  \item altogether, hardly, of one's own accord, in vain, back again
  \item inquisitive, envious, anxious, peaceful, silent
  \item foreign, honest, patient, generous, idle
  \item savage, wild, of the home, rare, frequent
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Moreover; however? (\textbf{autem}.) Indeed; but? (\textbf{vērō}.) Surely? (\textbf{profectō}.) About? (\textbf{ferē}.) Only; so much? (\textbf{tantum}.) Altogether? (\textbf{omnīnō}.) Hardly? (\textbf{vix}.) Of one's own accord? (\textbf{sponte}.) In vain? (\textbf{frūstrā}.) Back again? (\textbf{rūrsus}.) Inquisitive? (\textbf{cūriōsus, cūriōsa, cūriōsum}.) Envious? (\textbf{invidus, invida, invidum}.) Anxious? (\textbf{anxius, anxia, anxium}.) Peaceful? (\textbf{placidus, placida, placidum}.) Silent? (\textbf{tacitus, tacita, tacitum}.) Foreign? (\textbf{peregrīnus, peregrīna, peregrīnum}.) Honest? (\textbf{probus, proba, probum}.) Patient? (\textbf{patiēns, patientis}.) Generous? (\textbf{līberālis, līberāle}.) Idle? (\textbf{ignāvus, ignāva, ignāvum}.) Savage? (\textbf{saevus, saeva, saevum}.) Wild? (\textbf{ferus, fera, ferum}.) Of the home? (\textbf{domesticus, domestica, domesticum}.) Rare? (\textbf{rārus, rāra, rārum}.) Frequent? (\textbf{crēber, crēbra, crēbrum}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
